note: PRISM M4: the colour (base) maps upscaled locally from the player's own maps (never shipped: the outputs hold CE pixels). Only tags whose every non-resource use is a model shader's base map (soso.base_map) or the same image as a transparent shader's map are listed; multipurpose, detail, cube, normal and bump maps never are. scale: 'auto' = 4x when the larger side is 256 or less, else 2x.
